$comment: The same server with the mutation kill switch engaged. Every mutation tool is
absent from tools/list; the fifteen read tools continue to work. Useful for a
reporting-only client, or as a safe default while credentials are being proven.
For inline JSON select source=json and set GOOGLE_ADS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_JSON instead.
For keyless service-account ADC select source=adc; GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS is optional.
A manager ID and deprecated developer token are optional in service-account mode.
Start with version: 1 and accounts.allowedCustomerIds as ten-digit operator customer IDs.
Set mutations.enabled: true and mutations.default: deny; enable only chosen mutations.tools.
